findings.issue: Selected model did not establish an out-of-sample ranking advantage
findings.evidence: 20-session and 60-session IC bootstrap intervals are wholly below zero; all four mean confirmation ICs are negative
findings.required_interpretation: Preserve the negative result. Do not retune, invert scores, switch candidates using this confirmation, or describe the model as validated for live use

findings.issue: Nominal 80% return intervals under-cover at every horizon
findings.required_interpretation: Report undercoverage beside interval outputs; small positive 5/20-session Brier skill does not establish useful probability forecasting

findings.issue: Inherited factor interval-description field is inaccurate
findings.location: Frozen and latest factor metadata calibration.intervals
findings.correct_description: Per-horizon additive arithmetic-return residual quantiles around the factor arithmetic-return point; no factor log1p residual transform
findings.evidence: Executed hk_quant/models.py factor branch fits np.quantile(arithmetic return residuals) and predicts point plus residual quantiles; interval_log_residual_quantiles is empty
findings.disposition: Retain immutable weights and original metadata hashes. This review records the erratum; document it in the method explanation. No numerical refit is required

findings.issue: Initial rerun guard omitted existing data predictions and sibling latest-model destinations
findings.reproduction: Fresh results/model roots with original data root passed the initial guard despite existing prediction outputs; a fresh frozen child shared the existing latest directory
findings.resolution: Guard now protects data/predictions and models.parent/latest in addition to original result/model destinations; regression tests and direct read-only guard calls pass

findings.evidence: Fixed cohort benchmark preserves 12 unavailable slots in cash; its average equity fraction is 83.83%, versus selected-model 94.70%
findings.required_interpretation: State the 101-slot/cash design. SPY is a separate 95%-target adjusted-price ETF reference. All returns are conditional research illustrations
